user_request: Deliver a concise complete long-horizon experiment demonstration with the humanoid moving between workstations in the established laboratory.
experiment: One white-painted witness: mid-infrared reflectance measurement using a gold-reference substitution sequence.
robot: Official Unitree G1 29DoF rev1.0 with Inspire FTP hands

stations.purpose: Collect and finally return the ordinary tweezers.
Collect the identified witness from its existing bench support; no Cary measurement is claimed.
Gold background, sample loading, closed-compartment acquisition and unloading.
Place the measured witness on its declared clean support and protect the gold reference.

sequence.initial_configuration: OMNIC running with the installed DLaTGS accessory selected; sample/reference selector remains SAMPLE.

initial_conditions: Witness is already fabricated and coated; this demonstration starts from characterized material identities, not fabrication.
Spectrometer and accessory are installed, aligned and connected; controller software is configured before the demonstration.
Gold reference starts protected in its cap; the white witness starts at its existing Cary-side bench support.
Controller-PC representation and detector/purge connections must be checked against the complete scene before claiming readiness.
final_conditions: White witness rests on its assigned FTIR support.
Gold reference is protected in its cap.
Tweezers are returned to their supported staging pose.
Sample compartment is closed; both acquisition actions precede their corresponding unload.

sources.sections: Printed pages 52–53: Sample, Background, OK/Enter; OMNIC must be running.
Printed pages 4–5: direct sample placement, gold background, substitution method and protective cap.

presentation.camera: Room-wide views during transfer; unobstructed close views for contact actions.

current_verified_video.scope: Separate Cary access clip, not this complete measurement.
